source_title: PlayStation Launches Early Black Friday Deal With £20 Off Special Edition PS5 Controllers
source_excerpt:
That's over 30% off these special edition controllers
Black Friday may be a whole month away, but PlayStation is jumping on the autumn gaming deals first by letting you cut £20 off the price tag for its various special edition PS5 DualSense controllers.
Already underway after starting on Monday 26th October 2026, now lasting until Friday 6th November 2026, 23:59 pm (local time), UK and EU users can use a promo code at checkout to instantly get over 30% off the usual £69.99 or £74.99 DualSenses — now costing £49.99 and £54.99 respectively.
DualSense Wireless Controller - Death Stranding 2 LE
DualSense Wireless Controller - Ghost of Yotei - Black
DualSense Wireless Controller - God of War 20th Anniversary
DualSense Wireless Controller - Cobalt Blue
DualSense Wireless Controller - Sterling Silver
DualSense Wireless Controller - Volcanic Red
Mind you, this doesn’t include all PlayStation 5 DualSense controller colour schemes. For instance, you can’t get the discount for the default white controller or plain black controller; this discount only applies to special edition controllers designed around PlayStation games/franchises, and a couple of unique colour schemes.
All of the eligible PS5 controllers you can use the promo code below for £20 off are:
DualSense Wireless Controller - Death Stranding 2 LE (UK only)
DualSense Wireless Controller - Ghost of Yotei - Black (UK only)
DualSense Wireless Controller - God of War 20th Anniversary (UK only)
DualSense Wireless Controller – Marathon (UK and EU)
DualSense Wireless Controller - Cobalt Blue (UK and EU)
DualSense Wireless Controller - Sterling Silver (UK and EU)
DualSense Wireless Controller - Volcanic Red (UK and EU)
When you have all of the controllers you want amongst the above in your basket, simply enter DSB520OFFGB into the ‘Redeem Promo Code’ section , and £20 will be taken off each one — rather than just £20 for the whole basket.
You must also be fully signed in with your PSN ID for the code to work, as it will notapply the discount when being used at the guest checkout.
The early Black Friday sale does indeed also apply for PlayStation customers in EU territories wanting to get a cheaper PS5 controller as well, but you’ll need to instead use one of the following codes, depending on your regional territory.
